about.title: About Me
about.intro: Hello! I'm Mun, a Frontend Developer and UI/UX Designer based in Japan with 8+ years of experience. I specialize in modern JavaScript frameworks like React and Next.js, while also crafting beautiful, user-centered digital experiences.
about.development: On the development side, I build responsive, performant web applications. I'm proficient in TypeScript, Node.js, and various backend technologies, allowing me to tackle projects from end to end.
about.design: As a designer, I focus on creating intuitive interfaces through user research, wireframing, and prototyping. I believe great design solves problems while creating emotional connections.
about.personal: When I'm not coding or designing, you can find me gaming, reading, riding horses, or exploring new technologies. I'm always eager to learn and grow.
